notes: Renders: scratchpad/w2/q06-q10 + cu/c1-c10 (dpr2/ was empty). New real in-flight photos downloaded to ref/web/room/ (gitignored): tt_* (Thrifty Traveler), tpg_*The-Room* (TPG), fb_* (flatbeds.com.au), ff_* (Frugal Flyer), gstp_* (God Save The Points), r7_* (r7aviation), up_* (another rater). Colours are medians of the same element in render and photo (samp.py boxes). Cabin lighting in the model is warmer/dimmer than ANA's daylight photos; that biases the ash and fabric comparisons but not the shape issues.

details.detail: Nested-pair massing, 1.12 m walls, monuments, aisle-end ash wings with plaques

E seat's outer-side console: ash top runs the full 1.27 m from the monument to the back shell. In the photos the ash table is only at the footwell end; alongside the seat is a charcoal armrest/console
Shell/charcoal tone
Ash colour and grain
Seat cushion and back (tweed tone, seams, width)
Headrest flap: renders darker than the back. In every photo it is a paler blue-slate leather
Seat front / leg rest: reads as a detached thin board near the floor with a dark gap, not a continuous upholstered apron
Teal belt + buckle
Blue pillow: far too dark and saturated. It stands upright mid-cushion, and the white pillow is missing
Monitor, bezel, drawer + literature strip
Lamp column (reading light, air nozzle, safety-card pocket)
Cabinet door (ash, beside the monitor)
O side table / console: the rounded top is right, but the aisle-facing curved end of the console body should be ash-clad, not charcoal
Seat controls (handset + button cluster)
Footwell (ottoman pad, cavity, step)
Outer console with the red life-vest tab and stowage latch
Aisle armrest ledge with the privacy-panel slot
Aisle-end ash panels, cap, seat-number plaques
Centre divider
Doors (parked leading edge; closed state not reviewed)
Reading lights in the shell corners
Bed mode: mattress OK; the duvet is the wrong colour, too small, and has lengthwise stripes instead of a square quilt grid; the blue pillow is missing

issues.detail: E seat outer-side console is one long ash-topped slab (0.45 x 1.27 m)
issues.problem: roomPart('E') lays SEATMAT.ash over the whole outer console from MON.zE to 1.30. In every real photo, only the side table over O's footwell (about 0.45 x 0.5, at the monument end) is ash. Alongside the E cushion, the outer side is a charcoal armrest/console, the same as the other charcoal shell parts. It carries the stowage lids and the red life-vest tab. In q09, q10, c3 and c4 the model shows a huge pale ash bench beside every aisle-column seat. This is the most visible wrong surface in the room views.
issues.evidence: Same area. Render q09 (520,380)-(680,420) #aca89f (ash) vs c_27314 (250,270)-(300,300) #33353b (charcoal console under the ash wall band). c_27315: 14D's left side is a charcoal wing (#444854) with the small ash table only at the monument end (370-450, 290-400). fb_a96b7a65 (bed from above): no ash along the bed; the only ash is the table at the footwell end (bottom-left). Render c3_centre.png / q10_seat14D.png: ash slab runs the full seat length.
issues.fix: 09c_room.js roomPart E branch: split the console at zT = 0.62 (end of O's footwell). Ash only over the footwell: B.add(gRBox(0.45, 0.035, zT - MON.zE, 0.01, 1), M4.trs(-0.355, top - 0.018, (MON.zE + zT) / 2), ash), with the jRail band the same length. Give its aft seat-side corner a large radius (use planSlab(planRRect(-0.58, -0.13, MON.zE, zT, [0.004, 0.004, 0.11, 0.004]))) to match the O table. From zT to 1.30: a charcoal armrest at CON.top, B.add(gRBox(0.45, CON.top, 1.30 - zT, 0.01, 1), M4.trs(-0.355, CON.top / 2, (zT + 1.30) / 2), shell) + capRail(B, 0.45, 1.30 - zT, -0.355, CON.top, (zT + 1.30) / 2). Move the red tab (currently z 1.0) and a stowage-lid gRBox(0.004, 0.14, 0.30) onto its seat-facing face at x -0.128. Update roomPartFar('E') the same way: jShell box, with an ash box only for z < 0.62.

issues.detail: Headrest flap renders darker than the seat back; the photos show it clearly paler, blue-slate
issues.problem: jHead #6e7378 is tilted -8 degrees, so it faces the floor and sits in the AO/shadow of the shell top. In the cabin views it reads as a dark screen-like rectangle on every seat back (q06 rows 2-3 look like monitors on the seat backs). In every photo the flap is the palest thing on the seat: a cool blue-grey leather, lighter than the tweed.
issues.fix: 09_seats.js SEATMAT.jHead c '#6e7378' -> '#8a95a3' (cool slate), r 0.45 -> 0.38. In roomSeatCore, cut the flap tilt from -8 * DEG to -3 * DEG and move it 6 mm forward (z -0.058) so it is not buried in the shell-top AO. If AO darkening is per-material, exempt jHead.

issues.detail: Blue pillow far too dark and saturated; wrong pose; white pillow missing
issues.problem: pillowBlue #3e4677 with the yagasuri layer renders almost navy-black. The trip-report photos show a mid periwinkle/indigo jacquard pillow, and it is always paired with a large white pillow and a plastic-wrapped duvet leaning in the back corner. The model's pillow stands nearly vertical in the middle of the cushion like a box (q08, q10).
issues.evidence: Render q10 (720,430)-(820,520) #181e49 (lum ~31); q08 #191e4a. Photos: tt_seat-1 #4c5178 (lum 84, warm cabin light); tt_seats-center #737ba9 (126); fb_a96b7a65 pillow about #4b5789.
issues.fix: SEATMAT.pillowBlue c -> '#55609a', and cut the yagasuri albedo strength in LAYER_PARAMS[9] by about half so the check stays subtle. roomPillow placement: lean it against the back corner. For O, M4.trs(-0.40, 0.60, -1.12, Math.PI) with rotation (0.35, -62 * DEG); for E, mirror it. Add a white pillow behind it: gLoft(cushionSecs(0.50, 0.34, 0.10, -0.05, {edge:0.04,r:0.04})), SEATMAT.pillow, offset 0.08 toward the wall and 0.03 up.

issues.detail: Seat front / leg rest is a detached thin board
issues.problem: roomSeatCore's leg-rest loft (M4.trs(0, 0.06, -0.64, 0, -14 * DEG)) shows as a thin pale plank close to the floor, with a dark gap to the cushion (c5: a long strip poking out beside the table). In the photos the cushion front is a continuous upholstered apron that drops almost vertically to a dark kick strip.
issues.evidence: w2/cu/c5_seatO.png lower left (strip 0.56 wide, visible gap above it). c_27313 and c_27315: fabric apron under the cushion nose, no gap.
issues.fix: In roomSeatCore, replace the leg rest with a fabric apron hung from the cushion nose: loftAt(B, [SEC(0.0, w - 0.02, 0.04, 0, 0.015), SEC(0.30, w, 0.045, 0, 0.018)], M4.mul(M4.trs(0, 0.385, -0.635), M4.trs(0, 0, 0, Math.PI, 0)) with its own axis pointing down (or gRBox(w - 0.02, 0.30, 0.04, 0.015, 1) at M4.trs(0, 0.235, -0.64 - 0.02), F), and a jBase kick gBox(w - 0.06, 0.08, 0.03) at y 0.04. It must touch the cushion underside (y 0.39 - 0.0375).

issues.detail: Ash reads too dark and too warm/yellow everywhere
issues.problem: After the w2 grain change, the ash is still about 25-40 luminance darker than the photos and has a yellow cast (R-B about 13 vs 3-8 in the photos). Next to the lightened charcoal this cuts the ash/charcoal contrast that defines the look of THE Room.
issues.evidence: c_27313 aisle-end ash #e7e8e4 (231) vs q09 end ash #a09c92 (156); c_27314 back-wall ash #b7afa9 (177) vs the same wall in q09 #a09c92; c_27316 cabinet #b3a9a9 (172) vs q07 cabinet #89847b (132); c_27315 table #c9c6c2 (198) vs q10 table #a8a49b (164).
issues.fix: 09_seats.js SEATMAT.ash c '#c9c2b3' -> '#dcd8d0' and r 0.48 -> 0.42. If the lighting worker's warm cabin white is the cause, flag it to 12_scene.js; the ash should still come out near-neutral (R-B under 8) in q09/q10.

issues.detail: Seat controls look like generic black keypads
issues.problem: Real: a black pill/lozenge-shaped handset (rounded ends, about 0.19 x 0.065 m) with a colour screen in the middle and round D-pad clusters at both ends, set in a recess. Beside it, the button cluster has NO black backing plate. It is a set of backlit white-outline icon buttons printed directly on the charcoal console face: a small rocker at the top, then a row of 3 round buttons (the middle one blue-ringed), a long lie-flat pill of 3-4 seat-position icons, and a bottom row of 3. Model (c8): two black rectangles, a flat bright-blue screen and 8 white dots.
issues.evidence: ref/web/room/up_ANA-The-Room-Seat-Controls.jpg, gstp_ana-the-room-new-business-class-777-38.jpg (close-up of the button cluster), gstp-41, r7_img_0943.jpg, c_27316 (548-620, 190-270). Render w2/cu/c8_controls.png.
issues.fix: roomControls: handset as a capsule, B.add(gRBox(0.19, 0.065, 0.012, 0.032, 2)), SEATMAT.black, inside a jBase recess gRBox(0.205, 0.08, 0.004). Screen gQuad(0.085, 0.045) c '#6b8fd0' e 0.25 (softer, image-like, not flat cyan). Two 3-dot D-pads (gCyl 0.006) at ±0.07. Button cluster: remove the black gRBox(0.11, 0.075) plate. Instead add rows of gCyl(0.009) rings, c '#d8dde3' e 0.15 (outline look via a smaller jShell disc on top), at y +0.045 (a 0.05 rocker gRBox), +0.02 (3 rings, middle ring blue #6c9cff), -0.005 (a gRBox(0.075, 0.018, 0.003, 0.009) pill with 4 dots) and -0.03 (3 rings). The cluster is about 0.09 wide.

issues.detail: Aisle-facing end of the side-table console should be ash-clad (waterfall), not charcoal
issues.problem: In the photos the ash top wraps down the console's rounded aisle-facing end to about 0.1 m above the floor, with a charcoal kick. The charcoal face with the controls faces the seat. In the model, planBand makes the whole body charcoal.
issues.evidence: c_27312 centre (340-440, 330-480): curved ash face under the table; tt_suite-2.jpg right: ash vertical face under the ash top; tt_seat-2.jpg right console.
issues.fix: roomPart O: after the planBand body, add an ash skin on the curved corner and on the aisle-facing z0 end only. planSlab(B, planBand(tx0 + 0.010, tx1, tz0 + 0.010, MON.zO, R - 0.010, 0.006), 0.10, top - 0.141, ash), clipped to the corner and z0 run (or a separate gExtrude of the arc). Charcoal kick planBand at y 0..0.10. Do the same on E's shortened ash table (see the first issue).

issues.detail: Bed-mode duvet: wrong colour, stripes instead of a square quilt, and too small
issues.problem: The r3 QA moved the duvet to slate grey-blue #5a6478 (renders #9ba8bf in the studio). The real in-flight duvets are a clear medium indigo/royal blue with a square quilting grid of about 0.25-0.3 m, and they cover the full bed width, spilling into the footwell. The model has 1.1 m of lengthwise-channel stripes over part of the mattress. The blue pillow is also missing from the bed.
issues.evidence: fb_a96b7a65 duvet #4b5789, fb_d8b6dc0d #606ea0 (daylight), r7_img_1011 #303243 (dim night light), ff_...lie-flat-bed.jpg. Render w2/cu/c4_bedO.png (500,280)-(570,330) #9ba8bf.
issues.fix: SEATMAT.duvet c '#5a6478' -> '#4a5690'. In roomDuvet, lengthen to 1.5 m and centre it 0.2 m further toward the footwell; width w + 0.08 (hangs over). Replace the cross-stripe loop with a square grid: seams every 0.26 m in both x and z (gBox(0.003, 0.003, L) along z plus gBox(W, 0.003, 0.006) along x), c '#3a4476'. Add the blue pillow in bed mode (roomPillow lying flat beside the white pillow, as in fb_a96b7a65).

issues.detail: Lamp column: protruding light box with black knob lamps and a tiny safety-card quad
issues.problem: Real: the column is flush with the monitor housing and the dark charcoal side wall, not a lighter box standing 0.11 m proud with its own cap rail. The reading light is a recessed dark lens inside a pale grey metal ring, with a smaller ringed fitting below. The safety card is a full-size white/purple card (about 0.12 x 0.22) in a pocket at the column foot beside the footwell.
issues.evidence: Column: c_27316 #646a7a is dark and flush; q07 (665,300)-(695,360) #5a6578 is a box with two black cylinders. Ringed lamps in fb_a96b7a65 top-left and c_27315 (100-160, 300-350). Card: up_ANA-The-Room-Seat-6H.jpg bottom-left, c_27315 (200-270, 395-430) 'B777-300'.
issues.fix: roomColumn: depth d 0.11 -> 0.05, material jShellIn, drop capRail. roomLamp: outer gCyl ring c '#9aa0a8' m 0.6 r 0.3, then the jLens disc recessed 3 mm, radii 0.03 / 0.02. Safety card: gQuad(0.11, 0.21) c '#e9e6f0' with a '#5b3f8f' band (or an atlas card) in a jShellIn pocket gRBox(0.13, 0.16, 0.02), its top at MON.bot.

issues.detail: Aisle armrest ledge: too pale; ribbed aisle end missing
issues.problem: The ledge top renders almost white. In the photos the silver ledge has a stack of 3-4 horizontal ribs on its aisle-facing end face (visible in the trip photos as a louvred metal end).
issues.evidence: c_27313 ledge tops #788087-#b2bbc8 vs render c9 top ~#d0d4d8 (studio) / q08 #868c94 (cabin); ribs in tt_suite-2.jpg, tt_seat-2.jpg, tt_seat-1.jpg (bottom right of each seat).
issues.fix: roomLedge: add 3 ribs on the end face, for (k of [0,1,2]) B.add(gRBox(w - 0.03, 0.008, 0.012, 0.004, 1), M4.trs(x - 0.015, y - 0.015 - k * 0.018, z ± (L/2 + 0.012)), SEATMAT.jRail). Give the top slab SEATMAT.ashDark-like brushed grey #8f959c instead of jRail #b9bec4.

issues.problem: The real back shows 2-3 horizontal channel seams and the cushion a lengthwise seam; the model has one back seam. The tweed in the cabin views is slightly lilac (B > R by 13) where the photos are neutral-warm grey.
issues.evidence: c_27315 back #666371, c_27313 cushion #57555c; render q09 cushion #585663, q10 back #4e4c59.
issues.fix: roomSeatCore: add a second seam at BH y 0.44 and a lengthwise cushion seam. SEATMAT.jFabric c '#827f89' -> '#86838a' (less blue).

questionsForUser: Should seats show the boarding set-up that trip photos always show (plastic-wrapped duvet plus white and blue pillows leaning in the back corner), or only the blue pillow as now?
For bed mode, do you want the duvet turned down over the full bed (as in the flatbeds.com.au photo), or folded at the foot?
